name: Tourist Entry / Tourist Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Citizens of Brazil, Bolivia, Uruguay, Paraguay, Chile, Peru, Venezuela, Ecuador, and Colombia may enter with a valid national ID card or travel document instead of a passport.
Requires a valid passport (or, for the listed South American nationalities, a valid national ID card).
Tourists may not perform paid work during their stay.

evidence_required.document: Valid passport or, for exempt nationalities, national ID card

outcome.duration_length: Up to 3 months, extendable for an equivalent additional period

sources.title: Dirección Nacional de Migraciones -- Documentación para ingresar al país como turista: 3-month stay extendable once, ID-card exemption for 9 named South American nationalities, no paid work

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Argentina). This source page focuses specifically on the ID-card exemption for neighboring South American nationalities; it does not enumerate the broader visa-exempt nationality list (which includes most of Europe, North America, and many others under Argentina's general tourist visa waiver policy) or detail the separate Tourist Visa process for non-exempt nationalities (a linked but unfetched page, 'Obtener visa de turista para ingresar a la Argentina', exists at argentina.gob.ar for that group) -- flagged as a scope gap in this pass rather than guessed at a full nationality list.
